review.reviewer: Implementation owner (self-review against repository OpenSpec, CI, and cross-harness skill discovery contracts)
review.decision: Proceed with consolidating repository workflow into AGENTS.md, thin CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md pointers, cross-harness .agents/skills/ OpenSpec skills, and automated workflow guards
review.notes: Re-reviewed for @fission-ai/openspec@2.2.0 (--scope project --tools agents, with regular-file .claude/skills/ copies to satisfy scripts/ci.py symlink prohibition): 6 skills including openspec/SKILL.md + openspec/references/*.md, and removal of retired 1.x .claude/commands/opsx/.

evidence_limits: Automated Python unit tests verify workflow_guard.py negative/positive fixtures and ci.py path classification; real multi-harness IDE/CLI auto-loading is validated against each harness's documented discovery contract.

cases.description: Workflow guard accepts valid AGENTS.md, thin regular-file CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md @AGENTS.md pointers, and complete OpenSpec 2.2.0 cross-harness skills in the repository
cases.setup: Real repository root containing AGENTS.md, thin regular-file CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md pointers, and all six OpenSpec 2.2.0 skills (including openspec/references/*.md) under both .agents/skills/ and .claude/skills/.

cases.description: Workflow guard rejects missing AGENTS.md, symlinked pointers, missing @AGENTS.md import, and bloated/duplicated pointer files
cases.setup: Synthetic temporary repositories with (a) missing AGENTS.md, (b) symlinked CLAUDE.md, (c) CLAUDE.md missing @AGENTS.md, and (d) GEMINI.md duplicating ## headings.
cases.action: Run workflow_guard.check_repo(temp_root) on each malformed layout.
cases.expected: Each malformed fixture returns a non-empty error list naming the offending file and invariant.

cases.description: Workflow guard rejects missing or empty OpenSpec skills in either .agents/skills/ or .claude/skills/
cases.setup: Synthetic temporary repository missing openspec-propose in .agents/skills/ and with an empty openspec-archive-change SKILL.md in .claude/skills/.
cases.expected: Returns errors naming both missing/empty skill paths.

cases.description: CI path classifier treats AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, openspec/config.yaml, and OpenSpec skill/command markdown files as policy-only documents while keeping unknown files fail-closed
cases.action: Classify AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, openspec/config.yaml, .agents/skills/openspec/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/openspec/references/answers.md, .claude/skills/openspec-propose/SKILL.md, and an unrecognized script under .agents/.
cases.expected: Recognized instruction/skill/config docs select no heavy platform jobs (quality only); an unrecognized executable/script under .agents/ broadens to full CI.
